description: Settings to leave out of IntuneMigrationCandidates in Compare-GPOXml.ps1 and Compare-GPOHtml.ps1. Used only when the user answers Yes to the exclusion question or passes -ApplyExclusions. Set enabled to true or false to turn each entry on or off. A setting is excluded when an enabled entry's class matches (* = any, Computer, User) and any of its patterns matches the text 'Extension / Category / SettingName' (wildcards * and ?, case ignored). The XML script uses fixed extension names (Security, Administrative Templates, Advanced Audit Policy, Windows Firewall, Registry Settings, Local Users and Groups, NRPT); the HTML script uses the report's headings (Security Settings / Public Key Policies / ..., Administrative Templates / Network / ...). Excluded settings stay in ParsedSettings and the comparison reports.

exclusions.name: Firewall
exclusions.description: Windows Firewall profile and global settings, and Windows Defender Firewall Administrative Template policies. Firewall rules are not in IntuneMigrationCandidates; they are in FirewallRules.

exclusions.name: Registry
exclusions.description: Registry preference items (XML: Registry Settings) and registry permissions (Security Settings > Registry).

exclusions.name: Public Key Policies
exclusions.description: Certificate and Encrypting File System settings under Security Settings > Public Key Policies.

exclusions.name: File System
exclusions.description: File and folder permissions under Security Settings > File System.

exclusions.name: System Services
exclusions.description: Service startup modes and service permissions.

exclusions.name: Local Users and Groups
exclusions.description: Local group membership from Group Policy Preferences and Restricted Groups.
